patch_list: Neutralizes Mereframe's install-integrity checks so patched (re-signed) builds start normally instead of showing the installation-refused screen. Required for any other patch here to be usable.

libunnamed_raw.so JNI-throws 'app integrity check failed' on re-signed builds, killing camera session start (preview) - observed via diagnostic crash log. This patch calls the session-opening wrapper inside a real JVM try/catch (extension)…

DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - writes the full stack trace to Downloads/mereframe-crash-*.txt when the app crashes, for remote diagnosis. Off by default; enable when asked to produce a crash log. Chain-forwards to the original crash handler.
